question: Can the exact publicly released AbsoluteDegradation v1 code and blue-noise asset execute the paper's signal-dependent blue-noise grain term as published?

primary_source.paper_title: AbsoluteDegradation: A Physics-Inspired Synthetic Film-Degradation Pipeline and Archival Film Restoration Benchmark
primary_source.license: MIT for released software; bundled texture-asset provenance remains as stated by the paper/repository and is used only for this internal audit

branch_rule.pass: Retain only executable release-source evidence and separately test high-order transfer against P4CJ; no physical or product claim.
branch_rule.fail: Close the exact public release as an executable signal-dependent blue-noise grain baseline. Do not invent or regenerate a replacement asset under the same identity.

forbidden: replace, repair, renormalize or regenerate the released asset
change dtype, source hash, code path, offsets, sizes or gates after formal execution
treat scanner Gaussian noise as evidence that the blue-noise term executed
generalize a release-asset failure to the conceptual paper model or trained restoration results
copy the 40 MiB asset into the repository
claim_ceiling: Exact public-release source and arithmetic audit only; not a judgment of an unreleased intended asset, film stock, physical calibration, restoration quality or product suitability.
